text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: An ambush?! But Hecate of the Gale is always prepared for battle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
現れたな！　
だが、
この疾風の冥姫に死角はないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, Annie-girl! Wait!
There's something different about that thing this time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待って待ってアンナたそ！
こいつ、
さっきのとはアトモスフィアが違うよ！？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Yes, it looks like it's learned a few new tricks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
さっきと同じってわけじゃあなさそうね。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Then why don't we see what it can do? Teehee...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならばお手並み拝見、
ですわね……
クスクス。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Everyone, try to stay alert. Now, let's take it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
油断だけはしないようにね。
さあ、
締めてかかるよ！
